mission.title: Scheduled For Deletion
mission.description: Protect a pair of Exiles from Machine programs.

phase.briefing:
I'm glad you're back. I have a rather ... messy assignment for you. I certainly hope that you aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.
The Machines have deleted over a dozen of our clients in the last week. Because of this we need you to bodyguard two of the Merovingian's Exiles and move them to a new location before the Machines can trace them.

enter.say: We have a bit of problem ... A group of Machines just descended on Ugolino a few moments ago. You'll need to defeat the Machines that are on site before we can transport Ugolino.

objective.text: Lead Ugolino out of the building

phase.briefing: Don't stop now. Ginevra is waiting at the next location. I don't anticipate any hostiles, but then again ... I didn't think we'd run into trouble last time.

enter.say: Pick up the next Merovingian Exile and keep an eye out for hostile programs. Be sure that both Exiles make it to the base.

objective.text: Lead Ginevra and Ugolino out of the building
Do not let Ugolino or Ginevra die

phase.briefing: Be on the lookout for Zion or Machine attackers while you escort them to Mathilde's place.

enter.say: Leave both of them with Mathilde. He will take over from here.

objective.text: Lead Ugolino and Ginevra to Mathilde at the Merovingian base
Do not let Ugolino or Ginevra die
